messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - routing/pin mismatch causing customer 500s on embeddings/gen workloads. Auto-detected spike in 500s and content-type errors across eu-west and us-west. Pager notified oncall. thread_ts=1923456789

Raj (oncall): I'm awake, looking. seeing lots of 502/500 from route /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate. Customers calling both. Any recent deploys to routing/policies? :eyes:

Amy (sre): I see rollout events 1923456000 -> a config change last hour to fallback policy: `enable_variant_fallback: true` + a pin set to `model: redwood-chat-v2` at customer rule. That looks wrong for embeddings. Logs show fallback attempts where client requested embedding model but routed to chat variant -> downstream Adapter responded with 400/500 because endpoint contract mismatch.

Raj (oncall): tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. @Jordan @Lin can you confirm? For now paging customers saying we are investigating. Priya, can you surface affected customers?

Priya (cs): On it. Initial list: AcmeCorp (high traffic), Learnly, DocuSearch. I'll message their CSMs and offer status page link.

Jordan (eng-runtime): saw the same. Root cause appears to be a bad pin on a new routing rule that was intended for a canary of chat models but matched a wider set (priority mismatch). The policy used `match: model_family: 'openai-ish'` and unintentionally matched embeddings routes.

Lin (eng-ml): Confirmed. Chat vs embedding variants are incompatible. Our runtime attempted automatic fallback to the pinned chat variant when the requested variant wasn't available, which converted the request and caused schema errors in the emb adapter. We need to disable fallback for affected rule immediately.

Raj (oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) Roll back the routing change. 2) Set `allow_fallback: false` on rule. 3) Temporarily pin embeddings routes to a known-good embedding model. Which is fastest?

Jordan (eng-runtime): Option 2 is fastest (hotpatch toggle). I'll patch the policy config in prod router: runbook snippet below.

Jordan (eng-runtime): ```
# prod router hotpatch
patch /api/v1/routing/policies/6789
{
  "allow_fallback": false
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for routing-policy-6789 by jordan at 2026-03-15T02:32:10Z :rocket:

Ben (support): Customers seeing incorrect JSON shapes and 500s. Support is triaging tickets. Any ETA for fix?

Jordan (eng-runtime): Pushed the toggle. Waiting for config propagation (~30s-2min). Monitoring.

Amy (sre): Monitoring metrics: 500s on embeddings down from 62rpm -> 8rpm in last minute. Error type changed from AdapterError: incompatible-variant to RoutingError: fallback-disabled (so requests now fail earlier with 409 instead of 500). Still not ideal but reduces downstream 5xxs.

Raj (oncall): Good. Next step: revert the erroneous pin rule entirely and pin embeddings to stable `redwood-embed-v1` until we do a canary with correct match. Jordan, can you prepare rollback?

Jordan (eng-runtime): Preparing rollback. Rolling back routing change id=6789 -> initiating revert. Command: ```
POST /api/v1/routing/policies/6789/revert
{ "to_version": "2026-03-15T01:10:00Z" }
```

deploy-bot: rollback started for routing-policy-6789 by jordan at 2026-03-15T02:35:20Z :white_check_mark:

Lin (eng-ml): While rollback is in flight, we should add an explicit route override for known embeddings endpoints to avoid matching generic model_family rules. Example config: ```
- id: force-embeddings
  match:
    path_prefix: "/v1/embeddings"
  action:
    pin_model: "redwood-embed-v1"
    allow_fallback: false
```

Jordan (eng-runtime): Adding that now as emergency override. push in 30s.

Amy (sre): Observability: 95th latency for embed calls normalized, 5xx rate trending to baseline. Still watching. I'll hold page for 15 minutes.

Priya (cs): Sent interim message to impacted customers: "We're aware of increased errors for embeddings/generation in EU/US regions. Engineers are rolling back a routing change and applying overrides. No data integrity loss. We'll follow up with a postmortem."

Ben (support): Tickets updated. Customers appreciate the update.

Raj (oncall): After rollback completes, we need a postmortem and a runbook update so chat-canary pins don't match embeddings. Also add a test in PR gate: ensure routing rules with `match: model_family` don't apply to `/v1/embeddings` or `/v1/embedding` paths. Lin/Jordan can you own?

Jordan (eng-runtime): Agreed. I'll add a lint rule and e2e check in the routing repo. PR to follow.

Lin (eng-ml): I'll add a unit test in model-match library and a regression test that simulates embed requests hitting a chat model (should error at policy level).

deploy-bot: rollback complete for routing-policy-6789 at 2026-03-15T02:38:02Z :tada:

Amy (sre): Confirming metrics steady. 5xx for embeddings returned to baseline within 4 minutes of rollback. Marking paging resolved.

Raj (oncall): Great work. Actions assigned: Jordan -> routing lint + PR, Lin -> model-match tests, Amy -> update incident runbook and add metric alert for fallback->incompatible-variant, Priya -> customer followups + timeline. I'll convert to incident channel and schedule postmortem.

Priya (cs): I'll schedule calls for top 3 affected customers and draft incident summary.

Ben (support): Closing related tickets as service restored; will reopen if customers report new issues.

incident-bot: Incident task created: INC-2026-033 (postmortem queue). Severity: P0 -> downgraded to P1 after rollback and stabilized.

Raj (oncall): Thanks team. Postmortem to include root cause: overly-broad match in routing rule + fallback-on by default. Mitigations: stricter match semantics, default fallback off for incompatible product endpoints, routing rule staging checks.

Jordan (eng-runtime): I'll upload the config diff and timeline to the postmortem doc.

Lin (eng-ml): Also recommend adding an automatic test that sends an embedding request to any newly added chat model pin and asserts rejection at router level.

Priya (cs): Draft complete, will share with stakeholders in next 2 hours.

Raj (oncall): Closing thread in 2h if no regressions. Thanks all. :pray:
